تتبادرين (form VI)
# تَتَبَادَرِينَ (tatabādarīna) /ta.ta.baː.da.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of تَبَادَرَ (tabādara)
# تُتَبَادَرِينَ (tutabādarīna) /tu.ta.baː.da.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of تَبَادَرَ (tabādara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
